test.create_query: CREATE TABLE ts_order_statistics (id UInt16, timestamp DateTime, value Float64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (id, timestamp)
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO ts_order_statistics SELECT (number % 1000)::UInt16 AS id, toDateTime((intDiv(number, 1000) + 1) * 15) AS timestamp, (sipHash64(number) % 1000000) / 1000 AS value FROM numbers_mt(1000 * 5760)
